finding: Inspected the catalog's FIFO candidate and found the complete LRUCache implementation, its Cache base class and _DefaultSize helper in the pinned source window; also read the complete MIT license. Upstream LRUCache promotes successful reads and writes, evicts the least recently used key, and inherits non-promoting membership checks. Cache defaults to item counting but permits custom value sizing; its capacity validation does not enforce the requested integer-only contract. The relevant implementation depends on collections.OrderedDict and collections.abc.MutableMapping. Other module imports and local decorator helpers are unnecessary for this adaptation. Intentional changes: replace Cache inheritance and custom sizing with direct item counting, enforce nonnegative integer capacities excluding bool, explicitly reject zero-capacity insertion, and omit expiry, decorators and persistence. Separate value and recency dictionaries preserve upstream insertion-order key iteration without changing that order on reads. Mapping mixins provide get, pop, setdefault, update and views; successful value lookups promote recency. Keys must be hashable; this is a single-thread implementation with no synchronization. The full MIT notice is retained below. No code was executed or independently tested; operator acceptance tests remain separate.
